name: Bloom of the Heavens
label: Quest
description: Bloom of the Heavens: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Would you please deliver Nord'el to elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine?
The boat from here should be able to get you there swiftly.
I apologize for the request, I truly do. I remain fatigued from my journey here--and from fleeing those murloc devils when I first attempted to retrieve the sacred bloom!

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
